title: Export
description: Pick a format, adjust the rendering, then download or copy the result.

hints.png: Raster image, ideal for sharing or inserting in a document.
hints.svg: Vector image, sharp at any size and editable.
hints.pdf: One PDF page per exported page, ready to print.
hints.wispen: The whole document, to open and edit later.

embedFontsHint: Looks the same everywhere, heavier file.
copyUnsupported: This browser cannot copy this format.
copyDenied: The browser denied access to the clipboard.
